lessons.title: Present simple: be and other verbs
lessons.description: Using 'to be' (am/is/are) and action verbs to talk about routine, states and facts.
key_examples: They do not live in London.

lessons.title: Possessives and Demonstratives
lessons.description: Possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, its, our, their) and demonstratives (this, that, these, those).

exercises.q: Look at ___ bird over there in the tree!
exercises.explanation: That refers to a singular object at a distance.

lessons.title: Past simple: regular and irregular verbs
lessons.description: Forming past simple sentences with -ed and common irregular verbs (went, bought, saw, did).
key_examples: He bought a new laptop last week.

exercises.explanation: Past simple irregular form of 'go' is 'went'.

lessons.title: Comparatives and Superlatives
lessons.description: Comparing people, items and qualities with -er/-est and more/most.
lessons.formula: Adj-er than / More + Adj than / The most + Adj
key_examples: The blue whale is the largest animal.

exercises.q: This test is ___ (difficult) than the previous one.
